sheets.name: 00_README
rows: Enterprise Operating System Scientific-Equivalent Repository v0.1

Exact 40-sheet structural equivalent of the normalized scientific repository, populated with an enterprise operating-system ontology and a governed scientific-translation layer. Scientific analogies are hypotheses—not business authority—and are explicitly testable.
Composition, taxonomy, participation, state, transformation, control and evidence are distinct relations.
A mapping is accepted only when the scientific relation and enterprise behavior share a defensible structural mechanism.
The system may demonstrate eligibility; legal, policy and authorized-human responsibilities remain explicit.
Name is not automatically a proton
Identity-defining keys are context-specific; display names and contact points are often mutable interaction attributes.
A shipping or mailing address is a purpose-specific composite value object, not a nucleus by default.
Corrections, amendments, reversals and supersession preserve lineage.

sheets.name: 04_LEVELS

Typed value occurrences such as given name, currency amount, timestamp, identifier, quantity, code, and boolean.
Atomicity is contextual: one value, one datatype, one semantic role.

sheets.name: 12_LAWS
rows: Canonical Enterprise Invariants, Policies and Controls
Unlike physical laws, enterprise rules are designed, jurisdictional and versioned. Their deterministic behavior depends on complete facts and correctly governed implementation.
For each posted journal, total debits equal total credits.
Mutable descriptive attributes do not replace an entity unless a governed identity determinant changes under replacement policy.
Identity domain and survivorship policy defined
A governed transition occurs only when all mandatory applicable predicates pass or an authorized override is recorded.
Complete policy version and evidence scope
A correction creates a new effective state, reversal, or superseding record; it does not erase the prior valid historical assertion.
Executed state requires identified parties, authorized representatives, settled material terms, required approvals, and evidence of assent.
Jurisdiction-specific legal review may add predicates
Revenue is recognized only as applicable performance obligations are satisfied under the governing accounting policy.
Every material assertion used for action resolves to source, time, method or transformation, and responsible authority.
Incompatible initiation, approval, custody, posting, and reconciliation duties cannot be concentrated without governed mitigation.
A reconciliation is complete only when differences are zero within tolerance or individually explained, evidenced, owned, and time-bound.

sheets.name: 39_TRANSLATION_LAYER
rows: This sheet now carries the governed hypotheses linking the science repository to the brand-new enterprise model. It explicitly separates structural analogy from literal equivalence and records rejected mappings.
A primitive governed value occurrence is atomic only relative to the selected semantic grain; it is not physically equivalent.
Full Name is a composite value structure when represented by named components; it is not inherently a nucleus.
A governed identity determinant can play a proton-like role only inside a defined enterprise identity domain.
Mutable descriptive/contact attributes shape external interaction without ordinarily replacing core entity identity.
Postal address and money are better initial molecule-like candidates than nucleus-like candidates because governed components create new usable behavior.
A multiparty relationship is bond-like only when participation, cardinality, constraints and persistence are explicit.
Balanced debit and credit totals are a true computational invariant within double-entry scope, not a physical conservation law.
Lifecycle advancement follows permitted transition predicates; override must itself be governed and evidenced.
Enforceable commitment emerges only when lower-level terms, parties, authority and assent satisfy formation rules.
Business metrics require object, property, unit, method, time, source, conditions and uncertainty just as scientific measurements require context.
Event history preserves prior composition and state without claiming reversibility or physical causation.
Contract rules are designed, jurisdictional and defeasible; they must never be represented as universal natural laws.
